decisions.reason: LHD loaders build directly on the firm's core underground mining and tunnelling vehicle know-how, so it can assimilate customer feedback and keep improving the line despite missing website observations.

A construction site dumper is closely related to the firm's vehicle engineering and dump-truck know-how, but it was only mentioned briefly and there is no later evidence, which makes its value less certain.
Inclined furniture lifts draw on the firm's lifting and material-handling application knowledge and were presented on their own page, so the firm can interpret results and refine the models.
Inclined building material lifts fit the firm's construction and lifting expertise and its service capabilities, giving it the related knowledge to keep developing the line.
The truck-mounted variant combines the firm's vehicle and lifting knowledge, but as a single niche model with no later observations it carries somewhat higher withdrawal risk.
